newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Soymeal in Europe follows Chicago sharply up.
newsitem.headline: Soymeal in Europe follows Chicago sharply up.

text.p: Sellers on the European meals and feeds market offered South American soymeal pellets as much as $10 up this morning, following Friday's sharply higher Chicago soymeal futures close, market sources said.
Chicago soymeal futures soared $8 to $6 on rumours China had bought one to three cargoes of U.S. soybeans. The European sellers took a few dollars protection on top of Chicago.
Most other products were offered unchanged to a touch easier in sympathy with soymeal.
"The higher seller prices and a very strong dollar kept most buyers sidelined this morning," one broker said.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
